query:
-- 1. Reset 500-Pack Series: packsRemaining back to 500, reset pulled items
UPDATE repack_products SET packsRemaining = 500, updatedAt = NOW() WHERE id = 1;
UPDATE checklist_items SET isPulled = 0, updatedAt = NOW() WHERE productId = 1 AND isPulled = 1;

-- 2. Rename 100-Card Series to 100-Pack Series, set totalPacks to 100
UPDATE repack_products SET 
  name = 'NLF Marvel 100-Pack Series',
  description = 'The NLF 100-Pack Series delivers 100 hand-curated Marvel trading card packs for $100. Built around our three promises: a strong floor (every card has real collectible value), a better middle (quality cards throughout, not filler), and a healthy ceiling (real chase cards worth serious money). Cards from Topps Chrome Marvel, Marvel Mint, and other premium sets.',
  totalPacks = 100,
  packsRemaining = 100,
  updatedAt = NOW()
WHERE id = 30001;

-- 3. Rename 50-Card Series to 50-Pack Series, set totalPacks to 50, packsRemaining to 50
UPDATE repack_products SET 
  name = 'NLF Marvel 50-Pack Series',
  description = 'The NLF 50-Pack Series packs 50 premium Marvel trading cards into a $100 repack — higher card-for-card value with every pull. Built around our three promises: a strong floor (every card has real collectible value), a better middle (loaded with quality hits), and a healthy ceiling (legitimate chase cards worth serious money). Cards from Topps Chrome Marvel, Marvel Mint, and other premium sets.',
  totalPacks = 50,
  packsRemaining = 50,
  updatedAt = NOW()
WHERE id = 30002;
